topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: The words come out before I can stop them, a tapestry of thoughts I didn’t realize I held so tightly. “I knew it was too good to last, this slice of stability. You’ve always been the vibrant pulse in the gray, the one who made the mundane shine. And now, the horizon pulls you away, across the vast chasm of miles and minutes. It’s a cruel twist, isn’t it? Just as the pieces fit, they shift again. But you, you’ll bloom where you’re planted. I promise to hold down the fort, to guard the chapters we’ve written. The pages will get dog-eared and the edges will fray, but the stories will stay, waiting for more. So go, chase the new dawn. We’ll tie new threads, across the map.”
